title: Bauwerks Limewash on Exterior Tilt Panels — LDF Project
area_note: Square footage is derived from the North and West elevation drawings provided (scale 1/8" = 1'-0"). Wall heights are confirmed from dimension callouts: Floor 01 = 100'-0", Floor 02 = 116'-0", giving a panel height of 16'-0". Horizontal panel lengths are estimated by bay count at approximately 15' typical spacing. Openings (doors, windows) are deducted at approximately 12.5% of gross. This estimate covers the TP-3 limewash zones shown on those two elevations only. A revised estimate will be issued once full panel dimensions or a panel schedule is confirmed.

line_items.sub_note: Wipe down, remove form release residue, check for laitance — critical step on new tilt concrete before any mineral paint application
Tape and poly all openings and non-panel surfaces; Bauwerks limewash is highly alkaline and will mark any unprotected surface
Coverage approx. 75–100 SF/gal net for 2 coats. Est. 40 gallons. Color: architect's selection — price based on standard line; premium colors may vary.
Form release on new tilt panels can inhibit adhesion; allowance included pending confirmation from Bauwerks tech rep
Limewash applied by brush and sponge for authentic mineral texture; roller for field, brush for cut-in and panel edges
Est. 7 days; limewash requires controlled wet-on-wet technique for proper mineral bond — not standard production paint application
Est. 7 days; required to maintain wet edge across large tilt panels — cannot lap a dry edge with limewash without leaving visible lines

line_items.description: Scissor lift rental (26–32 ft working height)
line_items.sub_note: 16' panel height requires powered access equipment. Est. 8-day rental.

bid_range.low_note: Lean crew, owner supplies primer, no premium color
bid_range.high_note: Premium color, third coat, extended cure monitoring

assumptions: Area of ~3,360 SF covers TP-3 limewash zones on the North and West elevations as shown in the drawings provided.
Wall height of 16'-0" is confirmed from elevation dimension callouts. Horizontal bay lengths are estimated at approximately 15' per bay.
Two-coat application is standard for Bauwerks limewash on exterior concrete. A third coat may be recommended after reviewing panel surface texture on site.
New tilt concrete panels must be fully cured (min 28 days) and free of form release agent before application. A test patch on Day 1 is included in the labor allowance.
Color selection by architect — material pricing is based on the standard Bauwerks line. Premium or custom colors may affect material cost.
Sales tax on materials is not included in line items; estimate applies the Oklahoma rate of approximately 8.5%.
Weather windows are required. Limewash should not be applied below 40°F or during rain or high wind.
This estimate is valid for 30 days from the date of issue.
exclusions: South and East elevations — not included; drawings not provided.
Upper parapet panel zone — not included; TP-3 callout not confirmed for that zone.
Surface repairs, crack filling, or panel patching beyond minor prep.
Sealer or topcoat over limewash finish (not standard for Bauwerks; confirm with product rep).
system_note: Bauwerks is a mineral-based limewash that bonds chemically with cementitious surfaces rather than forming a film coat. On tilt concrete panels it provides excellent adhesion, natural variation in color depth, and full vapor permeability — meaning moisture in the panel can still move out without blistering or peeling the finish. It is UV-stable and low-maintenance, which makes it particularly well suited to large commercial exterior surfaces in the Oklahoma climate.
